note: THE ANCHOR CONTRACT (cinatra#2826, epic #2784 S9m) — the drift alarm between the design pin, the executable DOM expectations and the anchors a capture is graded against. `digest` is a sha256 over exactly three inputs: the acceptance manifest's `specCommit` (read from the manifest, never from here — the copy below is a readable mirror), the `domExpectations` recorded below, and the capture requirement anchors recomputed live from scripts/audit/lib/chat-hitl-capture-recorder.mjs. Moving the design pin therefore invalidates the digest by itself, and so does renaming an anchor, adding a host cell, weakening an observation or changing what a capture must observe. The only way back is an explicit re-ratification: re-examine the anchors against the drawing at the new pin and record the new digest by hand. `node scripts/audit/chat-hitl-acceptance-gate.mjs --print-anchor-digest` prints the recomputed value; nothing writes it, because a digest a script refreshes on its own alarms about nothing. The other half of the binding is src/lib/lifecycle/__tests__/anchor-contract-binding.test.ts, which asserts these `domExpectations` deep-equal the executable ones — so the code cannot move without this file, and this file cannot move without the digest. RE-RATIFIED 2026-08-22 (cinatra#2893): the pin moved to the §V addition drawing the ZERO-CHIP SETTLED READING, and the anchors were re-examined against it rather than refreshed. The two DOM expectation halves are UNCHANGED and that is the finding, not an omission — `carriage` names the ONE owner that draws each kind and the root declarations it is ruled by, and `hostParity` names which host draws each kind and how; the addition gives the recommendation card a new FACE for one state, not a new owner, a new root declaration or a new host. The capture requirements are unchanged for the same reason: a zero-chip settled capture is a `recommendation_hold` in the `decided` state, and the decided contract already asks for the state declaration inside the card root and the absence of every per-chip control — which is exactly what the outcome panel draws. The digest moved on the pin alone, which is the alarm working as designed.
